title: Windows Firewall GPO to Intune Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (migrate Windows Defender Firewall rules from GPO to Intune endpoint security; conflict/loop avoidance, coexistence, ringed cutover).
Distinct from windows-firewall-management (net-new firewall config); this is the GPO-to-Intune migration angle. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Move firewall rules from GPO to Intune — without policy conflicts or loops
problem: Migrating Windows Defender Firewall from Group Policy to Intune is a known minefield: do it before the foundation is ready and you get policy conflicts or merge/loop conditions that leave devices in an unpredictable state. This solution is the controlled firewall GPO-to-Intune migration — inventory and translate firewall rules into Intune endpoint-security firewall policy, manage GPO/Intune coexistence to avoid conflicts, and cut over in rings with validation, so the firewall stays correct throughout.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the firewall migration model, mapping GPO firewall rules to Intune endpoint-security firewall policy (and firewall rule profiles), why conflicts/loops happen and how coexistence prevents them, and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, the existing GPO firewall rule export, target device groups, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory GPO firewall rules, translate to Intune firewall policy, configure coexistence to avoid conflicts/merge issues, assign in rings, validate connectivity and rule enforcement, retire the GPO firewall settings, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — firewall-rule discovery (GPO + applied), post-migration rule-parity validation, a migration coverage and conflict report, safe remediation of conflicts, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The controlled Windows Firewall GPO-to-Intune migration — translate rules to Intune endpoint-security firewall policy, manage coexistence to avoid conflicts/loops, and cut over in rings with validation. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
